content:
Overview

Santa Marta is a city in MA with a population of 500,000. Colombia’s oldest surviving city, a Caribbean coastal gem with beautiful beaches and access to the Sierra Nevada. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
